create_RenderLightfield: create a RenderLightfield instance with a model to render RGB values from input rays
create_RenderSubdividedLightfield: create a RenderSubdividedLightfield with a model and subdivision to render foreground and background compositing
create_RenderMultipleLightfield: create a RenderMultipleLightfield instance to render RGB and alpha outputs from rays with optional include_all
run_over_composite_all: run over_composite_all to alpha composite RGB, alphas, and depths into final color and depth
run_render_chunked: run render_chunked to process rays in memory-efficient chunks through a render function
